ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 42, 0), rgb(255, 128, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

g.text: Apps → AWS WAF → API Gateway → Lambda; sign-in with Amazon Cognito.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 42, 0), rgb(255, 128, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

g.text: Laptop as extension display: laptop → home screen, via the app.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 42, 0), rgb(255, 128, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

g.text: AWS IoT Greengrass processes infrared/depth data on the device.

g.text: Event messages only (presence, fall, hazard) → IoT Core → EventBridge → Lambda.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 42, 0), rgb(255, 128, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

g.text: Lambda ↔ DynamoDB (profiles, consent, sessions) and S3 (content, packs, logs).

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 42, 0), rgb(255, 128, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

g.text: EventBridge → Amazon SNS → SMS and push alerts to users’ phones.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 42, 0), rgb(255, 128, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

g.text: Lambda → API Gateway → SaaS app catalog.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 42, 0), rgb(255, 128, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

g.text: Emergency: device → phone → cellular network → IoT Core → EventBridge → Lambda.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 42, 0), rgb(255, 128, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

g.text: Lambda → Location Service → IoT Core → phone → device projects exit routes.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 42, 0), rgb(255, 128, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));
